title: A novel deep learning model for a computed tomography diagnosis of coronary plaque erosion
summary: A momentum-distillation composite transformer learns CTA features to classify plaque erosion against OCT labels; it was evaluated on non-overlapping patient splits (316 development, 79 test patients), with test AUC 0.899 (95% CI 0.841–0.957). PPV was 71.1%, so this is retrospective diagnostic performance, not clinical deployment. This record is limited to the study result and does not establish independent replication or real-world benefit.
